shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,130p' && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '1,220p' && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names -- --fix && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test: consolidate validation error assertions" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
